## 7a15f5e5ebd9

**Classification: one reproduced API-contract defect; semantic design otherwise
clean; no edits made.** Source SHA-256:
`0ce11d69f53e5e5fd455a91078df585baf1eb1fab3f11cbf25738884a38cbd5b`.

The focused combined audit passed all 12 task-local tests and the strict semantic
gate. The full battery passed 11/12 stages; only `defect_lint` failed. Evidence:
`checks/audit/7a15f5e5ebd9-combined/result.json` and
`checks/audit/7a15f5e5ebd9-battery/checks/7a15f5e5ebd9_audit_battery_summary.json`.

The reproduced defect is strict scalar acceptance: 108 invalid values were
accepted—15 seed cases, 18 sample-index cases, 15 difficulty cases, 18 each for
`grid_h` and `grid_w`, and 24 for `n_anchors`. Examples include `seed=True`,
`sample_index=-1`, `difficulty=0`, `grid_h="8"`, and `n_anchors=5.75`. The root
cause is visible in `generate`: unknown override names are rejected, but call
arguments and numeric override types are passed to `gen_ctx` without exact-type
validation. See `..._audit_defect_lint.log`.

I found no separate semantic or distribution blocker in the measured scope:
lint, self-check, rule smoke, profile floor, semantic contract, diversity,
overrides, grammar, Racket lint, and authority synchronization all pass; the
12 focused tests include canonical linkage, cyclic-window identifiability,
clipping/overlap/color-priority witnesses, override boundaries, determinism, and
fixed-index diversity. The remaining limitation is finite declared-rival coverage,
as already documented in the target notes. Recommended change is the same narrow
pre-draw scalar validation used for the repaired target, with failing-first tests;
no rule or lesson redesign is indicated by this audit.
